svg.aria-label: Full TOML parsing benchmark results: MB/s per library and input
svg.text: Parsing: MB/s (higher is better) · key lookups: ns (lower is better) · bold = best in its group · shading = relative to that best (log scale)
FAIL = rejected a valid input · TIMEOUT = one parse took over 60 s · — = no lookup harness (lookup.sh covers TomlBeef and the Rust libraries) · * see the notes under the chart
